1|/**
     2| * Expo Config Plugin: Fix fmt 11.0.2 consteval compilation error with Xcode 26+.
     3| *
     4| * React Native bundles fmt 11.0.2 via RCT-Folly. Xcode 26 (Apple Clang 21)
     5| * enforces stricter consteval rules, causing FMT_STRING macro expansions
     6| * to fail. fmt 12.1.0 fixes this but RN hasn't upgraded yet.
     7| *
     8| * This plugin patches the Podfile post_install to:
     9| *   1. Set CLANG_CXX_LANGUAGE_STANDARD=c++17 for the fmt target (disables
    10| *      consteval by staying below the C++20 threshold).
    11| *   2. Patch Pods/fmt/include/fmt/base.h to force FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL=0
    12| *      as a belt-and-suspenders fix.
    13| *
    14| * References:
    15| *   - https://github.com/facebook/react-native/issues/55601
    16| *   - https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/issues/4740
    17| *   - https://github.com/expo/expo/issues/44229
    18| */
    19|
    20|const { withDangerousMod } = require('expo/config-plugins');
    21|const fs = require('fs');
    22|const path = require('path');
    23|
    24|const fmtPatchCode = `
    25|  # === FMT Xcode 26 consteval fix ===
    26|  # Fix fmt 11.0.2 consteval errors with Xcode 26 / Apple Clang 21+.
    27|  # The FMT_STRING macro calls consteval functions that fail under C++20.
    28|  # Strategy: (1) force C++17 for fmt target, (2) aggressively patch base.h
    29|  # to force FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL=0 by prepending an override, (3) patch all
    30|  # fmt headers that reference FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL.
    31|  installer.pods_project.targets.each do |target|
    32|    if target.name == 'fmt'
    33|      target.build_configurations.each do |config|
    34|        config.build_settings['CLANG_CXX_LANGUAGE_STANDARD'] = 'c++17'
    35|        # Also add a preprocessor define as belt-and-suspenders
    36|        defs = config.build_settings['GCC_PREPROCESSOR_DEFINITIONS'] || ['$(inherited)']
    37|        defs << 'FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL=0'
    38|        config.build_settings['GCC_PREPROCESSOR_DEFINITIONS'] = defs
    39|      end
    40|    end
    41|  end
    42|
    43|  # Aggressively patch base.h — prepend #define FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL 0 at the
    44|  # very top, before any detection logic runs. This is simpler and more
    45|  # reliable than regex-replacing specific lines.
    46|  fmt_base = File.join(installer.sandbox.root, 'fmt', 'include', 'fmt', 'base.h')
    47|  if File.exist?(fmt_base)
    48|    content = File.read(fmt_base)
    49|    unless content.include?('FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL_override_Xcode26')
    50|      override = "// FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL_override_Xcode26\\n// Force-disable consteval for fmt 11.0.2 + Xcode 26 compatibility\\n#ifndef FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL\\n#define FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL 0\\n#endif\\n\n"
    51|      File.chmod(0644, fmt_base)
    52|      File.write(fmt_base, override + content)
    53|      puts "Patch: fmt/base.h FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL=0 prepended for Xcode 26"
    54|    end
    55|  end
    56|
    57|  # Also patch format-inl.h and other fmt headers that may use FMT_STRING
    58|  fmt_include = File.join(installer.sandbox.root, 'fmt', 'include', 'fmt')
    59|  if File.directory?(fmt_include)
    60|    Dir.glob(File.join(fmt_include, '*.h')).each do |header|
    61|      content = File.read(header)
    62|      unless content.include?('FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL_override_Xcode26')
    63|        # Only patch headers that reference FMT_STRING or FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL
    64|        if content.include?('FMT_STRING') || content.include?('FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL')
    65|          override = "// FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL_override_Xcode26\\n#ifndef FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL\\n#define FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL 0\\n#endif\\n\n"
    66|          File.chmod(0644, header)
    67|          File.write(header, override + content)
    68|          puts "Patch: #{File.basename(header)} FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL=0 for Xcode 26"
    69|        end
    70|      end
    71|    end
    72|  end
    73|`;
    74|
    75|const withFmtXcode26Fix = (config) => {
    76|  return withDangerousMod(config, ['ios', (modConfig) => {
    77|    const podfilePath = path.join(
    78|      modConfig.modRequest.platformProjectRoot,
    79|      'Podfile'
    80|    );
    81|
    82|    if (!fs.existsSync(podfilePath)) {
    83|      console.log('[withFmtXcode26Fix] No Podfile found, skipping');
    84|      return modConfig;
    85|    }
    86|
    87|    let content = fs.readFileSync(podfilePath, 'utf-8');
    88|
    89|    // Check if we already patched
    90|    if (content.includes('FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL_override_Xcode26')) {
    91|      console.log('[withFmtXcode26Fix] Podfile already patched, skipping');
    92|      return modConfig;
    93|    }
    94|
    95|    // Find the post_install block and inject our patch before the final 'end'
    96|    const postInstallMatch = content.match(
    97|      /post_install\s+do\s+\|installer\|[\s\S]*?react_native_post_install\([\s\S]*?\)[\s\S]*?\n(\s*end\s*\n)/
    98|    );
    99|
   100|    if (postInstallMatch) {
   101|      const insertPoint = postInstallMatch.index + postInstallMatch[0].length;
   102|      content =
   103|        content.slice(0, insertPoint - postInstallMatch[1].length) +
   104|        fmtPatchCode +
   105|        content.slice(insertPoint - postInstallMatch[1].length);
   106|      console.log('[withFmtXcode26Fix] Injected fmt patch into post_install block');
   107|    } else {
   108|      // Fallback: try to find any post_install block
   109|      const simpleMatch = content.match(
   110|        /post_install\s+do\s+\|installer\|[\s\S]*?\n(\s*end\s*\n)/
   111|      );
   112|      if (simpleMatch) {
   113|        const insertPoint = simpleMatch.index + simpleMatch[0].length;
   114|        content =
   115|          content.slice(0, insertPoint - simpleMatch[1].length) +
   116|          fmtPatchCode +
   117|          content.slice(insertPoint - simpleMatch[1].length);
   118|        console.log('[withFmtXcode26Fix] Injected fmt patch into simple post_install block');
   119|      } else {
   120|        // Last resort: append a new post_install block
   121|        content += '\npost_install do |installer|\n' + fmtPatchCode + '\nend\n';
   122|        console.log('[withFmtXcode26Fix] Appended new post_install block with fmt patch');
   123|      }
   124|    }
   125|
   126|    fs.writeFileSync(podfilePath, content, 'utf-8');
   127|    return modConfig;
   128|  }]);
   129|};
   130|
   131|module.exports = withFmtXcode26Fix;

FROM oven/bun:1.2-alpine AS server-deps
WORKDIR /app

# NOTE: bun.lock is intentionally NOT required here. The GitHub sync pipeline
# (expo/sync-github.mjs) ignores bun.lock, so the lockfile in this repo can lag
# package.json (e.g. when a new dep like `unpdf` is added). `--frozen-lockfile`
# would then abort the build (the exact cause of prod being stuck on an old
# commit). Resolve fresh from package.json instead so new deps always install.
COPY package.json ./
RUN bun install --production

# Node 22 ships a native global WebSocket (Node 20 does not). @supabase/supabase-js
# initializes a Realtime WebSocket client in its constructor, so on Node 20 every
# createClient() call threw "Node.js 20 detected without native WebSocket support"
# before any owner-gated request could run. Node 22 (LTS) provides WebSocket natively.
FROM node:22-alpine AS runner
WORKDIR /app

# ffmpeg + ffprobe power the IVX video pipeline (HLS transcode ladder, thumbnails,
# posters) in backend/services/ivx-video-pipeline.ts and unlock the video worker
# (backend/services/ivx-video-worker.ts). Alpine's ffmpeg package ships both binaries.
RUN apk add --no-cache ffmpeg

# Chromium + deps power the IVX Browser Automation QA service. The install is
# intentionally non-fatal: if the Alpine package names/versions don't align with
# the current node:22-alpine base image, the container still builds successfully
# and the QA service degrades gracefully to status-only until the browser is
# available. The QA engine points to the system Chromium path and uses
# --no-sandbox / --disable-setuid-sandbox (required for the non-root Render runtime).
# NOTE: package names vary across Alpine versions (font-noto-emoji vs noto-fonts-emoji,
# ttf-freefont vs font-freefont). Try the known set, then a smaller fallback set.
RUN apk add --no-cache chromium nss freetype harfbuzz fontconfig font-noto-emoji font-freefont ttf-freefont noto-fonts-emoji 2>/dev/null \
    || apk add --no-cache chromium nss freetype harfbuzz fontconfig font-noto-emoji 2>/dev/null \
    || apk add --no-cache chromium nss freetype harfbuzz fontconfig noto-fonts-emoji 2>/dev/null \
    || apk add --no-cache chromium nss freetype harfbuzz fontconfig 2>/dev/null \
    || echo "[IVX-QA] Optional Chromium install failed; QA service will run in status-only mode"
ENV PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV PORT=3000
ENV HOST=0.0.0.0

# NOTE: we deliberately do NOT copy the `bun` binary into this Node runner.
# A hard `COPY --from=server-deps /usr/local/bin/bun ...` is FATAL if the source
# path differs between bun image versions, which froze production on the last-good
# image (the landing-SEO auto-deployer never ran). The autonomous lifecycle's
# step 6 already degrades gracefully to the in-process tsx import-smoke check when
# bun is absent (ivx-runtime-resolver), so the Node-only runner is fully
# self-sufficient and the build can never fail on bun setup.
